description: This file defines a static class 'Capabilities' within the 'MigraDoc' namespace, containing enumerations and nested classes related to feature availability, backward compatibility, and rendering settings for the MigraDoc PDF processing library. It includes configuration options and feature flags, particularly for handling unsupported features and backward compatibility considerations.

classes.name: Capabilities
classes.description: A static class that encapsulates various feature flags, compatibility settings, and actions related to the MigraDoc PDF rendering capabilities.

methods.name: Capabilities.FeatureNotAvailableAction
methods.description: An enumeration defining possible actions when a requested feature is not available in the current build, including do nothing, logging, or failing with an exception.

methods.name: Capabilities.BackwardCompatibility
methods.description: A nested static class providing flags and settings to handle backward compatibility and rendering behaviors, such as color handling and tab stop processing.

methods.name: Capabilities.Compatibility
methods.description: A nested static class containing flags related to rendering compatibility, such as handling of unsupported chart types.
